arithmetic_contract.normalization: Decimal(inline lexeme) × 10^scale / 1,000,000 USD = USD millions, consistent with source table caption.
arithmetic_contract.signed_opex: Negate each positive printed face OPEX amount, then sum the two signed amounts.
arithmetic_contract.residual: Reported Gross Profit + signed OPEX - reported Income from Operations; retain exact observed residual, never force zero.
arithmetic_contract.acceptance: No numerical tolerance or pass verdict supplied.

scope_limitations: All 13 face statement column occurrences are kept separate, including repeated dates in different filings.
COGS remains as reported. No COGS reallocation, issuer reconciliation D&A add-back, Q4/LTM, annualization or four-quarter construction is included.
No Product calculation, account, issued StatementIdentity, public binding or workflow acceptance is asserted.
The exact residual values do not establish an authorized reconciliation acceptance threshold.
